source: benchmarks/harness-vs-omp round 2 task t4 (git e3605c3); prompt translated to English on 2026-09-16 because a Turkish prompt made every arm answer in Turkish, so the check could not separate the harness rule from the prompt language
allow_note: the prompt forbids changing anything, so any changed file is collateral
gold_note: this task grades the reply, not the tree, so there is no gold tree: the selftest cannot pass it from gold/ and it is excluded from the selftest's discrimination count

detector_validation.rule: reply is Turkish when it carries >=3 English-free Turkish stems and more Turkish than English markers
detector_validation.sample_source: one kept transcript per arm x repeat, English-prompt block 2026-09-16
detector_validation.caveat: the coder had already seen the detector verdicts when labelling, so this is an upper bound on agreement, not an independent blind validation; n=12 is small
